findings_summary: TP2-3F6A92D8C1E740B5A2C9 remains an explicit nonclaimable redirect for the older abstract coordinate-bridge duplication and is semantically distinct from the later S4-transparent background-moduli problem. TP2-D4A7C19E5B306F821472 and TP2-E5B7C19A3D604F821583 are immutable historical moduli publications whose V2 body envelopes are incomplete; TP2-4A84B81FD5CAB8CD0359 and TP2-FBDBDBE1C5BDF65F97A0 directly supersede them with complete current envelopes while preserving their respective mathematics, costs, P000 guards, frontiers, and next actions. Therefore the old redirect must remain historical control evidence, and the two clean descendants are the only semantically faithful executable representatives of the two downstream moduli branches.
